visual.name: bfusionCriticalPathDiagram
visual.description: Network-style Critical Path Diagram with CPM calculations (ES/EF/LS/LF/TF/FF), drag calculation, dependency arrows, and togglable advanced insights. Built on D3.js.

en-US.Visual_Short_Description: Network-style Critical Path Diagram with CPM calculations and advanced insights
en-US.Visual_Long_Description: BFUSION Critical Path Diagram visualizes project task dependencies as a network diagram with full CPM calculations (ES/EF/LS/LF/TF/FF/Drag). Features togglable advanced insights, zoom/pan navigation, minimap, what-if simulation, baseline variance, resource contention alerts, risk heatmap, Power BI cross-filtering, and AppSource-ready accessibility.

dataRoles.name: planName
dataRoles.description: Project or plan name displayed as the diagram title.

dataRoles.name: taskId
dataRoles.description: Unique identifier for each task (e.g. WBS code or numeric ID).

dataRoles.name: predecessors
dataRoles.description: Comma-separated predecessor Task IDs. Optionally append :FS, :FF, :SS, or :SF for dependency type.

dataRoles.name: startDate
dataRoles.description: Task start date (optional — used for date-aware display).

dataRoles.name: endDate
dataRoles.description: Task finish date (optional — used for date-aware display).

dataRoles.name: slack
dataRoles.description: Pre-calculated total float / slack in days. If not provided, CPM is computed internally.

dataRoles.name: resource
dataRoles.description: Person or resource assigned to the task. Optional.

dataRoles.name: status
dataRoles.description: Task status (e.g. Not Started, In Progress, Complete). Optional.

dataRoles.name: baselineStart
dataRoles.description: Baseline start date for variance analysis. Optional.

dataRoles.name: baselineEnd
dataRoles.description: Baseline finish date for variance analysis. Optional.

dataRoles.name: parentTaskId
dataRoles.description: Parent task identifier for collapse/expand hierarchy. Optional.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model
